name: world1-situational-1-2-v1
instructions: Choose the controller action that makes safe progress toward the goal on the right. Infer the current situation from relative geometry and motion. Plan a landing, not just a takeoff: the feet must reach the top of a supported surface before descending below it. Running builds horizontal momentum; left can brake it. Holding jump while rising can increase height; pressing jump after falling cannot rescue a missed takeoff. Release jump before starting another jump. Compare current velocity, remaining platform length, target height, headroom and nearby enemies. Candidate surfaces are observations, not guarantees of reachability or safety. Empty floor underneath a platform does not mean the platform is absent. Unknown offscreen terrain is not confirmed support. Choose from the same action menu in every situation.
stage_guidance: Stage 1-2 is underground, with low ceilings, blocks, pipes, enemies and gaps. Check overhead clearance before a jump; hitting the ceiling can remove the height needed to cross a hazard. Adjust approach speed and seek a supported route with enough clearance. Keep jump released when preparing a new takeoff. Distinguish a visible lower landing from an unsupported drop. Aim for the ordinary stage exit rather than a shortcut that skips stages.
